svg.text: Three rungs: what Codex may do, and what a wrong answer costs you
Looks at files and answers questions. Nothing is written, nothing is run.
A wrong answer costs you: a wrong sentence.
WORKSPACE (Codex may call it Auto) · stay here
Edits inside the folder it was started in. Must stop and ask before leaving that folder,
using the network, or running a command the sandbox flags.
A wrong answer costs you: a change you can see with git diff and undo.
FULL ACCESS · never on your laptop
No sandbox, no questions: any file, any command, anywhere. The --yolo flag starts here.
A wrong answer costs you: deleted files, with no undo.
Commit before you let an agent edit. Git is the undo button that Codex does not have.
